name: object-with-private-fields-negative-test-2196e80b05/runtime-object-equivalence-v
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Import declarations"; "Class definition"; "Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members"
Expressions: "Check expression", "Trap expression", "Type cast expression", "New expression", "Field access expression"
reason: The case exercises supported class fields and cross-module object typing: a public-field object is widened to userA and any, then casting it to userB must fail because userB has a non-public zipcode field. Trapping the cast panic and propagating its error are supported expressions. No restriction excludes field visibility or this runtime object cast behavior.
test_design_notes: The expected output asserts a TypeCastError for pkg.org_foo:user to pkg:userB; io:println only exposes the trapped error.
